game: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time
comment: Text speed: a port of NotRexed/Hookshot#402 by way of zortos293/Lichii#1422.

main+0xAFE140 steps a text pane's letter animation. At 0xAFE1B4, the start of the letters' block, s0 holds the frame time that moves the letters' clock (+0x60 += rate * time) and counts down pauses (+0x58 -= time); the auto-advance timer before it keeps the game's time. The site branches to a cave that scales s0 (s16 is unused in the function), redoes the displaced ldrh and branches back.
All three are one group: with more than one checked, the first in this list (the fastest) applies.

patches.name: Text Speed Instant (built-in)
patches.description: Dialogue, the fairy's hints and signs appear at once. Text that closes by itself in cutscenes keeps its timing. With more than one Text Speed checked, the fastest is used.

records.comment: b main+0x3C46F00, over the ldrh the cave redoes
ldr s16, scale ; fmul s0, s0, s16 ; ldrh w9, [x19, #0x6e] ; b main+0xAFE1B8 ; scale: 1e6 (a page at once, a frame per pause, like the game's own skip on A)
